subject: Mutual Action Plan: Acme Corp POC & Procurement Timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & Mutual Action Plan: Redwood POC for Acme Corp

Hi Tom and Lena —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum. Please confirm stakeholders and dates below so we can lock resources on our side.

Key pain points you shared:
- Unpredictable inference costs at scale (spiky traffic + high per-token spend)
- 99th percentile latency spikes impacting UI responsiveness
- Need for predictable capacity and data residency in us-east-1
- SOC 2 and encryption evidence required for procurement

Goals you mentioned:
- Run a 4-week POC to validate latency and cost targets
- Reduce per-token inference cost by ~40% vs current setup
- Meet 99th %-ile latency < 250ms for high-concurrency queries
- Procurement + legal signoff for production by end of March / early April

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (draft):
1) Kickoff & scoping call — target: Feb 22 (or week of Feb 22)
   - Acme stakeholders: Tom Harris (Eng), Lena Ortiz (PM)
   - Redwood: Marissa Cole (AM), Dylan Brooks (Solutions Eng)
   - Deliverable: finalized success criteria and POC SOW

2) Provision POC environment — target: Mar 1
   - Redwood to provision dedicated test capacity in us-east-1, share runbook and access
   - Deliverable: POC access + test dataset sample instructions

3) Integration & evaluation — Mar 8 to Mar 22
   - Integration support, test harness, run latency/cost benchmarks, iterate prompts
   - Deliverable: POC report with latency/cost metrics and recommendations

4) Procurement / contract review — target: Mar 25
   - Acme procurement/legal to review SOW/terms; Redwood to provide SOC2 summary and security docs
   - Deliverable: signed SOW or PO

5) Go / No-Go decision — target: Apr 1
   - Decision owners: VP Eng (Acme), Redwood account exec + Solutions Eng

Action items for Acme (please confirm):
- Confirm procurement lead and legal reviewer (name + email)
- Confirm availability for kickoff (proposed Feb 22 or Feb 24)
- Share any urgent security questionnaire items now so Dylan can prep answers

Attachments: redwood-poc-proposal.pdf, sow-draft-acme.docx (attached)

If Feb 22 is tight, we can move kickoff to Feb 24 — let me know what works and I’ll calendar the meeting.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference (www.redwood.ai)

Subject: Re: Recap & Mutual Action Plan: Redwood POC for Acme Corp

Marissa — thanks for the clear plan and recap. That aligns with what we discussed. A couple notes from our side:

- Procurement lead will be Sanjay Patel (sanjay.patel@acme.com) — I’ve looped him in separately.
- Decision process: VP Engineering (R. Gupta) needs to approve the technical report; procurement to approve PO.
- Kickoff: Feb 22 is tricky for a few folks. Can we target Feb 24 (Tue) for the kickoff call? Our engineering team is available between 10:00–12:00 PT that day.
- Security: we do have a short vendor security questionnaire. Please share SOC2 summary and encryption-at-rest/in-transit details — I’ll forward the questionnaire to Dylan.

No objections to the MAP otherwise. Once you confirm Feb 24 and share the POC SOW, I’ll get our procurement and legal to review.

Tom
